settings.title: Brand identities and digital products for companies with something to say.

settings.editor: I am Juno Vale, an independent designer in Lisbon. For twelve years I have helped founders, publishers and makers look like what they are, and work the way they promise.

settings.title: Tidewater Coffee Roasters. Identity and packaging, 2025
Product design for a walking journal

settings.editor: Most projects start as one of these and borrow from the others. All of them start with a conversation.
A name people can say, a mark they can draw from memory and a system your team can use without calling me. From strategy to guidelines.
Interfaces for web and mobile, designed in the browser as early as possible. I work inside your team, with your engineers, in two-week cycles.
Campaigns, book covers and packaging. I bring in the photographers, illustrators and printers the job needs, and stay until it is on the shelf.

There is no account manager and no junior team. You talk to the person doing the work, which keeps projects short and decisions clear. When a job needs more hands, I bring in people I have worked with for years.

settings.title: “Juno asked better questions about our business than our investors did. The identity came out of the answers.”
Inês Bragança, founder of Tidewater Coffee Roasters. A sample quote.
